name: tree
title: Tree
description: A hierarchy to browse: folders and files, categories, with nodes that open and close.

when: Data with parents and children people browse: files, categories, an org chart.

instead.when: A few sections of content, not data.

guidance.rule: Keep labels short; three or four levels at most.

builtIn: Arrows move, Right opens and Left closes a node, Home and End jump; the chevron and Enter expand.
